draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.46, the 243rd-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 37th of 39 at LB. He went 175th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (243rd): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 66 tackles in 2019, 25th of 39 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2021. 16 career games and 7 starts over 2 completed seasons. Career-best season: 3 AV in 2020. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (14th percentile). Played 6 of 17 games in 2021.
